# AIES — AI Engineering Standard

> The LLM is one component. The harness is the product.
> Scaffold a production AI harness in 5 minutes — open, vendor-neutral working standard.

Site: https://open-ai-engineering-standards.vercel.app
Repository: https://github.com/grvmithas/open-ai-engineering-standards
Steward: Gaurav Mithas (https://open-ai-engineering-standards.vercel.app/about)

## Get started (3 steps)

1. /start — Onboarding (goal → role → maturity → IDE → model → data class → stack)
2. /quickstart — Your kit (install `.aies/` via npx)
3. /workflows — First lifecycle workflow

## Systematic navigation (after install)

- Learn: /docs/handbook/README · /docs/patterns/README · /docs/08-ai-sdlc/README
- Operate: /workflows · /quickstart · /docs/handbook/hooks-in-practice
- Assure: /portal · /docs/handbook/ai-migration-bible-path · /docs/handbook/evals-as-quality-gates

## Other entry points

- / — Product homepage
- /docs/principles — Engineering principles
- /docs/roadmap — Adoption roadmap
- /about — Steward profile and contact

## CLI

- `npx @grvmithas/create-aies-kit` — install IDE-native harness (`.cursor` / `.github` / `.claude` …) — no `.aies/` folder


## Topics covered

Harness principle, AIDLC, runnable patterns, prompt/context engineering, skills vs agents, MCP, memory/RAG, evaluation gates, LLMOps, HITL, hooks, enterprise SoA, AI migration path.
